Morning.english: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening.
We have entered a new morning and with it all dominion is Allah’s.

Evening.english: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning.
We have entered a new evening and with it all dominion is Allah’s.

Before sleep.english: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

Traveling.english: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us.

Gratitude.english: All praise is due to Allah who has fed us and given us drink.
